command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=${CONDA_PREFIX:-/opt/conda}/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out /var/tmp/work
echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
( cd /tmp/inst && sha256sum -c /tmp/institutions.sha256 ) > /tmp/out/pins.check 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/out/pins.check; echo "FAIL: a part does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
echo "0ad8eda028ae76a62308cf692d3fc8953fa37d0bfc408ef9e9c568ccef7941de  /tmp/real.R" | sha256sum -c - || { echo "FAIL: real.R does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
echo "$(wc -l < /tmp/institutions.sha256) parts + real.R match their pins"
uname -m | tee /tmp/out/arch.txt
lscpu | grep -E '^(Model name|Thread\(s\) per core|Core\(s\) per socket|Socket\(s\)|CPU\(s\)):' | tee /tmp/out/lscpu.txt
T0=$(date +%s)
Rscript real.R /tmp/inst /tmp/manifest.json /var/tmp/work /tmp/out  2>&1 | tee /tmp/out/real.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "real.R exit $RC in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s" | tee /tmp/out/wall.txt
echo "memory.peak_gib $(awk '{printf "%.2f", $1/1073741824}' /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak 2>/dev/null)" | tee /tmp/out/footprint.txt
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: the workload failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'JSONLITE REAL OK' /tmp/out/real.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
test -s /tmp/out/score.tsv || { echo "FAIL: no score.tsv"; exit 1; }
( cd /var/tmp/work && sha256sum lossless.json ) | tee /tmp/out/lossless.sha256
echo DONE
